# AthermalRandomFieldBlumeCapel

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A spin model with quenched random fields at zero temperature, where Glauber dynamics drives phase transitions without thermal fluctuations. Provides a tractable framework for studying non-equilibrium phase transitions in disordered systems, relevant to robust computation in noisy topological networks.
